messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: paste0
parts:
Hi,

can you provide a small example to reproduce this error?

For your information: the paste0() function is not available in Renjin, but paste() should obviously work. Instead of rewriting your code to replace paste0() with paste(), you can define your own version of paste0() as Andrie explains in the following SO answer: http://stackoverflow.com/a/21230815.

Maarten-Jan
